subject.title: fix(codex): keep progress replies from ending active turns

question: After the cross-runtime instruction mismatch is fixed, should Codex `message_tool_only` completion permanently require explicit `final: true`, or should OpenClaw preserve implicit terminal delivery and rely on prompt steering?
rationale: This PR and the competing prompt-only PR establish different permanent completion and upgrade contracts; code correctness alone cannot select that product boundary.

options.title: Adopt scoped explicit intent
options.body: Keep the runtime guarantee, but expose and describe `final` only in Codex `message_tool_only` runs before merge.

options.title: Keep implicit completion
options.body: Use the prompt-only candidate and preserve every confirmed current-source send as immediately terminal.

recommendation.title: Adopt scoped explicit intent
recommendation.body: Keep the runtime guarantee, but expose and describe `final` only in Codex `message_tool_only` runs before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implicit completion behavior appears to date to the source-reply terminal recognition work they authored and merged.
